CVE-2005-2475.description: Race condition in Unzip 5.52 allows local users to modify permissions of arbitrary files via a hard link attack on a file while it is being decompressed, whose permissions are changed by Unzip after the decompression is complete.

sources.text: The affected product relies on third-party components that are not actively supported or maintained by the original developer or a trusted proxy. The following CVEs are associated with this product.CVE-2021-34803, CVE-2020-13699, CVE-2019-18988, CVE-2018-16550, CVE-2018-14333, CVE-2005-2475 have been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 5.3 has been calculated; the CVSS vector string is (AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L).

Race condition in Unzip 5.52 allows local users to modify permissions of arbitrary files via a hard link attack on a file while it is being decompressed, whose permissions are changed by Unzip after the decompression is complete.
